visualCharacteristics: A vertical stack of feature rows, each with an image on one side and a heading/paragraph (optionally a CTA) on the other. The image/text sides alternate row to row (z-pattern) on desktop; rows stack to a single column on mobile.
contentPattern: One row per feature, each with two cells: one holding an image, the other holding a heading, paragraph, and optional CTA link. Image/text order alternates automatically for every other row.
usage: Use for a series of feature highlights that alternate image and copy sides down the page.
